SPACE HEX TACTICS

Assemble both fleets. You command every ship on your side unless you hand it to the AI.
8 impulses per turn; spend energy and fire at any impulse. Velocity carries over until you burn to change it: burn 2 (reverse 4) for cruisers, half that for frigates/destroyers, one burn per impulse. Turn-burns: frigates/corvettes every impulse, other ships every other impulse (Dreadnought every 3rd); reverse burns every other impulse. Rotation per impulse (pivots + turn-burns together): cruisers 60°, small ships 90° (Hunibler/Hunifer more, Dreadnought 30°). Shield generator at 25/50/75/100%; below 100% shields are capped at that share and can't be reinforced or repaired; if it goes off, shields collapse. Reinforcement and base-shield repair cost 1 energy per point (max 2 points/impulse; reinforcement lasts one turn, up to 2× shields). With "Weapon charging: over time", guns drain their load cost evenly while they reload. Hover a ship to see its weapons and outline; click the ⚑ faction button to pick a faction.
